description: You are in an ancient barrow which opens to the southwest.
title: Inside the Barrow

description: Halls lead west and south. The Wizard's workbench dominates the room. It is stained from years of use, and is deeply gouged as though some huge clawed animal was imprisoned on it. In the center of the bench, three stands - ruby, sapphire, and diamond - form a triangle.
title: Wizard's Workshop

description: You are on a north-south bridge spanning a deep ravine. Water flows far beneath.
title: Stone Bridge

description: The far half of this room is depressed. The only exit is west.
title: Pool Room

description: This is the southern end of a garden, where fantastically shaped hedges are arrayed with geometric precision. Though recently untended, the bushes have clearly been shaped: There is a dragon, a unicorn, a great serpent, a huge misshapen dog, and several human figures. To the west is a tunnel.
title: Topiary

description: This room is full of assorted machinery, whirring noisily. On one wall is a triangular button labelled, "DANGER -- HIGH VOLTAGE." There are exits to the south and southwest.
title: Machine Room

description: Inscribed on the floor is a great pentagram drawn with black chalk. In its center is a black circle.
title: Pentagram Room

description: In the center of this enormous room, four wooden posts support a huge oblong roof. To the east is a large hole; to the west a gaping chasm.
title: Posts Room

description: This was once a kennel for a large dog (some of the bones would fit a dinosaur). The only exit is northeast.
title: Kennel

description: This is a tall, damp room with brick walls. There are some etchings on the walls. A passage leads west.
title: Circular Room

description: This is the entrance to a huge tomb. A passage leads north.
title: Cerberus Room

description: The air is cool and damp. A path from the southeast splits here; north toward a stone bridge, and west into a narrow tunnel. It is from the latter that the chill originates.
title: Cool Room

description: An oblong table here is set for afternoon tea. It is clear that the users were indeed mad. To the east is a small hole (perhaps four inches high). A doorway leads west.
title: Tea Room

description: The rock walls are scarred by flame, and a blackened doorway leads south.
title: Dragon's Lair

description: This is a small chamber carved from the western end of a short crawl. On the wall is crudely chiseled the number "8".
title: Room 8

description: You are in a huge crystalline sphere filled with thin blue mist. The mist becomes white to the west. You strain to look out through the mist... You see a dreary room with an oak door and a huge table. There is an odd glow to the mist.
title: Room of Blue Mist

description: You are waist deep in a cold stream. On the northern bank, the walls rise to a small ledge. A "whir" comes from an opening to the south.
title: Deep Ford

description: Here a dark hallway turns a corner. To the south is a dark room, to the east is fitful light.
title: Aquarium Room

description: This is a gazebo in the midst of a formal garden. It is cool and restful here. A tea table adorns the center of the gazebo.
title: Gazebo

description: You have made it to the top. Well done. There are etchings on the well. A crack runs across the floor at the doorway to the east, but it can be crossed easily. Another doorway leads northeast.
title: Top of Well

description: The walls of this large cavern are scorched and a sooty dry smell is very strong here. A stone bridge leads the south, and a smokey tunnel opens to the north. To the east is a small opening.
title: Dragon Room
